plugin.name: ooc_wiki
plugin.author: Ferdinand
plugin.purpose: search and read the Order of Chaos alliance wiki in-game
plugin.description:
Searches ooc.dune.net (guest access) and shows pages in the output window.
* ooc <search term> -- search the wiki * ooc <number> -- open an entry from the last result list * ooc list -- show the last result list again
One hit (or an exact title match) opens the page directly; otherwise a numbered list is shown and entries can be clicked or picked by number.
Uses HTTPS when TLS is available (always on MacMUSH; on MUSHclient install LuaSec for HTTPS) and falls back to plain HTTP otherwise.
Keep mm_http.lua and ooc_wiki.lua in the same folder as this plugin.

muclient.script:
local COLOURS = { heading = "gold", bold = "white", italic = "palegreen", text = "silver", dim = "gray", link = "cornflowerblue", pre = "wheat", error = "tomato", -- empty string = the client's default output background (both clients -- keep their current background for an empty colour name) background = "", }
local function file_exists(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then f:close() return true end return false end
local plugin_dir = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 20) or "" assert(file_exists(plugin_dir .. "mm_http.lua"), "ooc_wiki: mm_http.lua must sit next to ooc_wiki.xml") assert(file_exists(plugin_dir .. "ooc_wiki.lua"), "ooc_wiki: ooc_wiki.lua must sit next to ooc_wiki.xml") package.loaded.mm_http = nil package.loaded.ooc_wiki = nil package.path = plugin_dir .. "?.lua;" .. package.path local http = require "mm_http" local wiki = require "ooc_wiki"
local client local base_url local pending local last_term local last_results
local function note(style, text) ColourNote(COLOURS[style] or COLOURS.text, COLOURS.background, text) end
local function emit(lines) for _, line in ipairs(lines) do for _, r in ipairs(line) do if r.style == "link" and r.action then Hyperlink(r.action, r.text, r.action, COLOURS.link, COLOURS.background, 0) elseif r.style == "url" and r.url then Hyperlink(r.url, r.text, r.url, COLOURS.link, COLOURS.background, 1) else ColourTell(COLOURS[r.style] or COLOURS.text, COLOURS.background, r.text) end end Note("") end end
local pump_scheduled = false
local function schedule_pump() if pump_scheduled then return end pump_scheduled = true DoAfterSpecial(0.1, "ooc_pump()", sendto.script) end
function ooc_pump() pump_scheduled = false if client and client:tick() then schedule_pump() end end
local function ensure_client() if client then return end client = http.new() base_url = client:tls_available() and "https://ooc.dune.net" or "http://ooc.dune.net" end
local function begin_request(opts) if pending then client:cancel(pending) end pending = client:request(opts) schedule_pump() end
local function show_page(index, others) local result = last_results[index] local page_url = base_url .. "/" .. result.href begin_request{ url = base_url .. "/action=browse&id=" .. result.href .. "&raw=1", callback = function(resp) pending = nil if not resp.ok then note("error", "ooc: could not fetch '" .. result.title .. "': " .. tostring(resp.err)) return end local raw = http.latin1_to_utf8(resp.body or "") if string.match(raw, "^%s*$") then note("error", "ooc: page '" .. result.title .. "' is empty or unreadable") return end emit(wiki.render_page(result.title, raw, page_url)) if others and others > 0 then note("dim", string.format("(%d other pages matched -- ooc list to see them)", others)) end end, } end
local function show_list() if not last_results or #last_results == 0 then note("dim", "ooc: no previous search -- try: ooc <search term>") return end emit(wiki.render_results(last_term, last_results)) end
local function do_search(term) begin_request{ url = base_url .. "/", method = "POST", headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" }, body = "search=" .. http.urlencode(term) .. "&dosearch=1", callback = function(resp) pending = nil if not resp.ok then note("error", "ooc: search failed: " .. tostring(resp.err)) return end local found = wiki.parse_search(resp.body or "") last_term = term last_results = found.results if found.count == 0 or #found.results == 0 then note("dim", "ooc: no pages found for '" .. term .. "'") return end local exact = wiki.find_exact(term, found.results) if #found.results == 1 then show_page(1, 0) elseif exact then show_page(exact, #found.results - 1) else show_list() end end, } note("dim", "ooc: searching for '" .. term .. "' ...") end
function ooc_command(name, line, wildcards) local arg = string.gsub(wildcards[1] or "", "^%s+", "") arg = string.gsub(arg, "%s+$", "") ensure_client() if arg == "" then note("dim", "ooc <search term> -- search ooc.dune.net" .. " | ooc <number> -- open result | ooc list -- show results") return end if string.lower(arg) == "list" then show_list() return end local index = tonumber(string.match(arg, "^(%d+)$")) if index then if not last_results or #last_results == 0 then note("dim", "ooc: no previous search -- try: ooc <search term>") elseif not last_results[index] then note("error", string.format("ooc: pick 1-%d (or ooc list)", #last_results)) else show_page(index, 0) end return end do_search(arg) end
function OnPluginClose() if client then client:cancel_all() end end
function OnPluginDisable() if client then client:cancel_all() end end
